_note: The two specialists of the story (doc/story_tree.md, Thân VII). bodyguard: a soldier of the guard branch of rank minRank or more, given one villager to keep (sim.setBodyguard); while he lives and stands within `within` tiles of that villager he takes `share` of every blow meant for him, and he keeps his post (guardAt) within `stay` tiles of him. assassin: a hidden foe sent by a village (sim.sendAssassin): walks to one target, unseen until a soldier or guard is within revealRadius (a tower within towerRadius), strikes once for strikeMult times the health of the target (before armour), then runs home; fleeSeconds is how long he may run before he is gone. A blow reveals him for revealSeconds. spawnDist: tiles from the fire where he appears. units: the seven specialist soldiers the legacy may open (doc/UPDATE_di_san_mo_khoa.md; unlocks.json lists the keys). Each is trained in the camp `camp` like a core soldier of the same Nhà chung level (his rank is that level, from 4 to 10), wears one fixed suit (`weapon`, `armor`, `mount`) taken from the stores (`hire`: it comes with him), and is worth the core of the same rank by trade-offs (`profile`: factor on each stat). costMult: the price of the core rank; rationAdd: more food a day than the core. stealth: unseen by the enemy beyond 3 tiles. siege: his blows on walls, gates and towers hit this much harder. ambush: his blows from behind hit this much harder. effects: what each specialist building that stands and each power of a tip does (src/sim/legacyfx.ts): elder_hall betrayMul (chance a tributary turns on us), tribute_post tributeMul, bodyguard_lodge wardSlots (more bodyguards for one villager; 1 without it), liaison_post aidDays (allies called to keep the village, once a season), twin_camp squadsAdd, conquest_beacon marchMul (pace of a squad on the march), memorial_shrine grudgeDamage (our blows on a hostile village), academy researchSlots (researches under way at once), hidden_forge gearCostMul (weapons and armour); powers: coalition allyMul (allied soldiers), eyes warnDays (raids told earlier), mercenary hireCostMul (hired specialists), reconcile relationLossMul (relation a tribute costs), refuge relationGainMul (relation gained).
